name: navigation-menu
title: NavigationMenu
description: Site or app navigation with panels of links, on Base UI's NavigationMenu: a <nav> row of titles that open panels in one shared popup, links with descriptions and a current-page mark, and plain links in the row.
usage: Use NavigationMenu for the top navigation of a web build or a docs site, where entries group several destinations: Workspace (connections, saved queries, history), Administration. Compose it as NavigationMenu > NavigationMenuList > NavigationMenuItem (value) with a NavigationMenuTrigger and a NavigationMenuContent of NavigationMenuLinks (href; active for the current page), or a NavigationMenuLink straight in the row with className={navigationMenuTriggerStyle}. It navigates; for actions use Menubar or DropdownMenu; for an app's side navigation use Sidebar; for views of one place, Tabs.

props.name: value
props.description: NavigationMenu: the open entry (controlled); defaultValue when uncontrolled; null when closed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: NavigationMenu: called when an entry opens or the menu closes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: NavigationMenu: the direction of the row and of its arrow keys.

props.name: delay
props.description: NavigationMenu: ms of hover before a panel opens.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes; navigationMenuTriggerStyle makes a link look like a row entry.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: The shared popup's positioner under the row, at z.popover, with the row's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="navigation-menu-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: The shared popup, color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay, sized to the open panel; data-slot="navigation-menu-popup".

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The trigger's chevron, turned while open; data-slot="navigation-menu-icon".

parts.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
parts.description: A title button with aria-expanded and a chevron; color.interactive.hover while hovered or open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuContent
parts.description: An entry's panel of links, size.panel.md wide, shown in the shared popup.

parts.name: NavigationMenuLink
parts.description: A link: a row with a title and a muted description in a panel; data-active and aria-current="page" when active.

states.name: open
states.description: A trigger whose panel is open keeps color.interactive.hover; its chevron turns.

states.name: entering
states.description: The popup and a panel fade in over motion.duration.base; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: hover
states.description: A trigger or link under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

accessibility: A <nav> landmark holding a list; triggers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls; panels hold ordinary links, the current one with aria-current="page".

Tab moves along the row; Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a trigger's panel and Tab moves into its links; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between entries; Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger.
Hovering a trigger opens its panel after a short delay; moving to another trigger switches panels in the same popup.
Links in the row look like triggers but stay links (Enter follows them).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the fades and the chevron's turn off.
The popup takes the row's theme and density and sits at z.popover.
